reasoning: The icon depicts a split image frame with inverted tones across a vertical divider, the standard symbol for visual before-and-after comparison, image diffing, or tone/contrast editing. While abstract at a quick glance, it fits specific tasks around side-by-side visual comparisons (remodels, progress photos, UI diffs, photo retouching), though generic non-visual 'compare' tasks (like comparing insurance quotes) should use an icon for the object being compared.
